slides.headline: A $600 MILLION MAN SAID YOU DON'T NEED SAVINGS
THE TREASURY SECRETARY SAID STOP SAVING
slides.body: Scott Bessent went on national TV and said Americans will soon be able to skip retirement savings entirely. His argument: AI will grow the economy so fast that nobody will need a safety net. He's the man in charge of America's money

slides.headline: HE BLAMED EVERYTHING ON AI
slides.body: Bessent claims AI will generate so much new wealth that the entire concept of saving for old age becomes outdated. No timeline given. No safety net for the millions of Americans who can't afford to wait for a technology that hasn't delivered yet

slides.headline: THE INTERNET DESTROYED HIM
slides.body: People pointed out Bessent's estimated net worth: around $600 million. One viral reply: "He, his children, and their children will be just fine." Critics say telling people to stop saving is easy when you'll never run out

slides.headline: OWNERS ALREADY CUT 20 HOURS A WEEK
slides.body: Bessent promises AI will save everyone someday. Smart owners already use AI to handle emails, scheduling, and reports that eat 20+ hours a week. No government program, no new hires, no waiting for Washington

slides.headline: HE WON'T BE THE LAST
slides.body: More politicians will use AI as an excuse to cut what you count on. Follow @yaffeai so you see it the day it happens. Send this to the friend who thinks their retirement plan is untouchable
